meta.scope: Official-source logistics review covering fuel, overnight and access planning for all 19 routes, with leg-specific guidance for remote or ambiguous approaches.
meta.disclaimer: Road conditions, gates, fees, fuel availability and seasonal access can change. Reconfirm directly before departure.

fuelAnchors.name: Khorixas
fuelAnchors.note: Primary supply point before or after the Twyfelfontein sector.

fuelAnchors.name: Kamanjab
fuelAnchors.note: Reconfirm fuel before continuing toward Galton Gate.

fuelAnchors.name: Okaukuejo
fuelAnchors.note: NWR lists a filling station and shop inside Etosha; confirm current operation.

gatePermitNotes: Etosha is accessed through named gates including Galton, Andersson, Von Lindequist and King Nehale; choose the gate that matches the booked camp and daylight available.
Park travel between sunset and sunrise is restricted; check current gate times with MEFT or NWR.

legs.guidance: Use Khorixas and Kamanjab as supply checks and confirm whether Galton Gate suits the booked Etosha camp. The collection coordinate represents the park, not a navigable gate, so no single distance is published.

sources.label: Namibia Wildlife Resorts — Etosha access notice

fuelAnchors.name: Opuwo
fuelAnchors.note: Fill and provision before departing the northwest.

fuelAnchors.name: Kamanjab
fuelAnchors.note: Reconfirm fuel and gate conditions before Etosha.

fuelAnchors.name: Okaukuejo
fuelAnchors.note: NWR lists fuel and shop services; confirm availability before relying on them.

gatePermitNotes: The western approach normally aligns with Galton Gate; confirm entry eligibility, booked camp and daylight gate hours before leaving Opuwo.

legs.guidance: The park coordinate is not a gate. Route through Kamanjab and navigate to the confirmed Etosha entrance and booked camp rather than routing to the park centre.

fuelAnchors.name: Maun
fuelAnchors.note: Complete fuel, water, food, tyre and recovery preparations before entering Moremi.

fuelAnchors.name: Kasane
fuelAnchors.note: End-of-route resupply point after the Chobe sector.

gatePermitNotes: Reserve campsites and park access before departure.
Use a fully equipped 4×4 and obtain same-day track and water reports; do not treat general-purpose road routing as an expedition time estimate.

legs.guidance: Select the gate and campsite first, then obtain a current track plan from the booking office or local operator.
Water levels and sand conditions change the usable track; confirm locally before leaving camp.
Treat this as a remote transfer and confirm the open track, fuel range and realistic daylight time.
Route from the actual riverfront gate rather than the collection’s park-centre coordinate.

fuelAnchors.name: Zomba
fuelAnchors.note: Refuel before the Liwonde sector.

fuelAnchors.name: Liwonde town
fuelAnchors.note: Confirm fuel before entering the park or continuing toward the lake.

fuelAnchors.name: Mangochi
fuelAnchors.note: Practical resupply check on the approach to the southern lakeshore.

gatePermitNotes: Use the current visitor entrance identified by Liwonde management and confirm accommodation transfer instructions before routing to a park coordinate.

legs.guidance: Navigate to the confirmed visitor gate or lodge instructions, not the park-centre coordinate.
Exit through the confirmed gate, check fuel in Liwonde or Mangochi and verify the final lakeshore road before departure.

fuelAnchors.name: Kongola
fuelAnchors.note: Confirm fuel and supplies before the wetland detour.

fuelAnchors.name: Katima Mulilo
fuelAnchors.note: Primary regional resupply and MEFT permit-check point.

gatePermitNotes: Nkasa Rupara requires a 4×4 with recovery equipment and self-sufficient preparation.
Official guidance says fees can be arranged through MEFT in Katima Mulilo or Windhoek or upon arrival; reconfirm the current process.
Flooding can make much of the park inaccessible, so obtain same-day access advice.

legs.guidance: Use a 4×4 and confirm flood conditions, bridge access, campsite and recovery readiness locally.
Do not use the park-centre routing estimate; obtain an exit track and daylight-time estimate from park staff or the booked camp.

sources.label: Visit Namibia — Nkasa Rupara National Park

fuelAnchors.name: Chipata
fuelAnchors.note: Main refuel and provisioning point before the Luangwa Valley.

fuelAnchors.name: Mfuwe
fuelAnchors.note: Reconfirm fuel and supplies before park drives or remote extensions.

gatePermitNotes: Use the usual Chipata–Mfuwe approach unless a competent operator confirms a seasonal 4×4 alternative.
Park entry and self-drive fees change; verify current charges before arrival and collect a current loop-road map at the entrance.

legs.guidance: Zambia Tourism describes this as the usual approach and notes that the road can be corrugated.
Mfuwe is immediately outside the park area; route to the booked lodge or confirmed entrance instead of the park-centre coordinate.

fuelAnchors.name: Beira
fuelAnchors.note: Fill before the Gorongosa approach.

fuelAnchors.name: Inchope
fuelAnchors.note: Official park directions identify a fuel stop near the EN1 junction; confirm operation.

fuelAnchors.name: Chimoio
fuelAnchors.note: Primary provisioning and fuel point before Chimanimani.

gatePermitNotes: There is no fuel for sale inside Gorongosa according to the park’s driving guidance.
Chimanimani recommends a 4×4; some areas require a long walk or 4×4 access, so confirm the trailhead, guide and camping arrangement.

legs.guidance: The official tourism site recommends a 4×4 from Chimoio. Confirm the exact gate or trailhead and current surface before leaving the city.

fuelAnchors.name: George
fuelAnchors.note: SANParks identifies George as a major Garden Route supply and fuel centre.

fuelAnchors.name: Knysna
fuelAnchors.note: Refuel and provision before continuing east along the N2.

fuelAnchors.name: Storms River Bridge
fuelAnchors.note: SANParks lists fuel about 25 km from Storms River Mouth; confirm current operation.

gatePermitNotes: Garden Route National Park is split across Wilderness, Knysna and Tsitsikamma sections; route to the booked rest camp or named day-visitor gate.
SANParks gate hours and conservation fees vary by section and season; verify them before arrival.

legs.guidance: Choose Storms River Mouth, the Big Tree or the booked accommodation entrance before navigating; the collection stop covers a wider region.

sources.label: SANParks — Moving around the Garden Route
SANParks — Storms River Mouth Rest Camp

fuelAnchors.name: Dullstroom
fuelAnchors.note: Top up before the Panorama Route mountain sector.

fuelAnchors.name: Hazyview
fuelAnchors.note: Final outside-park fuel and supply check before the selected southern Kruger gate.

fuelAnchors.name: Skukuza
fuelAnchors.note: Use booked-camp services only after confirming current availability and opening hours.

gatePermitNotes: From Hazyview, SANParks identifies Paul Kruger Gate for Skukuza and Numbi Gate for Pretoriuskop; select the gate that matches the booking.
Allow wildlife-speed travel time inside Kruger and arrive before the current gate-closing time.

via: Paul Kruger Gate or Numbi Gate
legs.guidance: Do not navigate to the park-centre coordinate. Choose the entrance and allow SANParks' slower in-park travel time to the booked camp.

fuelAnchors.name: Lusaka
fuelAnchors.note: Complete fuel, cash, food and tyre preparations before the Lower Zambezi transfer.

fuelAnchors.name: Chirundu
fuelAnchors.note: Refuel and obtain current access advice before the rough Chiawa or Chongwe sector.

fuelAnchors.name: Siavonga
fuelAnchors.note: Refuel before the long paved transfer toward Livingstone.

overnightAnchors: Booked Lower Zambezi lodge or camp
gatePermitNotes: Zambia Tourism recommends a 4×4 on the rough Chirundu–Chongwe access and notes that lodges often arrange transfers; confirm the booked property's directions.
Lower Zambezi park fees and self-drive charges can change; reconfirm them before departure.

legs.guidance: The collection coordinate does not identify a lodge or gate. Confirm whether to drive, park for a boat transfer or use a lodge transfer before leaving Lusaka.
Obtain the current exit route and transfer timing from the lodge; wet-season access can differ from the mapped road.

sources.label: Zambia Tourism — Lower Zambezi National Park

fuelAnchors.name: Victoria Falls
fuelAnchors.note: Fill and provision before the Hwange sector.

fuelAnchors.name: Hwange town
fuelAnchors.note: Reconfirm fuel before entering through the selected park gate.

fuelAnchors.name: Bulawayo
fuelAnchors.note: Major resupply point before Matobo Hills.

overnightAnchors: Hwange Main Camp or booked lodge
gatePermitNotes: ZimParks identifies Mpofu for Main Camp, Mbala for Sinamatella and Nantwich for Robins; choose the entrance that matches the booking.
Confirm current park tariffs, payment method, road condition and gate hours directly with ZimParks.

legs.guidance: Route to the gate serving the booked camp rather than the park-centre coordinate.
Confirm the chosen park entrance and accommodation directions before leaving Bulawayo.

fuelAnchors.name: Maputo
fuelAnchors.note: Start with a full tank and current EN1 road information.

fuelAnchors.name: Xai-Xai
fuelAnchors.note: Principal mid-route fuel and supply check between Bilene and Chidenguele.

fuelAnchors.name: Inhambane or Maxixe
fuelAnchors.note: Refuel before beach-road detours to Tofo or Barra.

gatePermitNotes: The official Coast of Lagoons corridor follows Maputo–Bilene–Xai-Xai–Inhambane; verify EN1 conditions and daylight arrival with the booked property.
Final beach approaches can differ by accommodation; use the property's current directions and do not assume every sand track suits a two-wheel-drive vehicle.

legs.guidance: Use Xai-Xai for the main-road fuel check and confirm the final lagoon turn-off with the accommodation.
Tofo and Barra use different final approaches; follow the booked property's current directions.

fuelAnchors.name: Maseru
fuelAnchors.note: Fill, check tyres and provision before entering the highlands.

fuelAnchors.name: Thaba-Tseka
fuelAnchors.note: Reconfirm fuel and weather before the Katse sector.

fuelAnchors.name: Hlotse or Butha-Buthe
fuelAnchors.note: Use the lowland return corridor as the final dependable supply check.

gatePermitNotes: Mountain weather, fog, snow and rockfall can alter highland travel times; obtain same-day road advice before each crossing.
Confirm Katse and Mohale visitor-centre tour times and access requirements with the Lesotho Highlands Development Authority.

legs.guidance: Check the chosen road, weather and daylight margin locally; a faster-looking map alternative may not be the appropriate surfaced route.
Reconfirm mountain conditions and visitor-centre timing before departure.

sources.label: Visit Lesotho — National Tourism Master Plan

fuelAnchors.name: Mbabane
fuelAnchors.note: Start the short circuit with fuel and cash sorted.

fuelAnchors.name: Ezulwini or Matsapha
fuelAnchors.note: Convenient central-corridor resupply before Malkerns and Mlilwane.

gatePermitNotes: The official Royal Heartland itinerary uses Ezulwini as a base for Lobamba, Malkerns and Mlilwane.
Confirm Mlilwane day-visitor or overnight check-in times directly with Big Game Parks.

legs.guidance: Use the entrance and check-in directions supplied for the booked Mlilwane accommodation or activity.

sources.label: Big Game Parks — official parks portal

fuelAnchors.name: Maun
fuelAnchors.note: Fill both vehicle tanks where fitted and complete food, water, tyre and recovery preparation.

fuelAnchors.name: Nata
fuelAnchors.note: Primary fuel and supply reset before the Kasane leg.

fuelAnchors.name: Kasane
fuelAnchors.note: Regional resupply point for the Chobe Riverfront.

gatePermitNotes: Reserve national-park campsites and entry before departure and travel with a fully equipped 4×4.
Nxai Pan lies off the Nata–Maun road, but sandy park tracks and wet-season conditions require current gate advice; do not navigate to a park-centre coordinate.

via: Confirmed Nxai Pan gate and campsite
legs.guidance: Confirm the gate, campsite booking, track condition and fuel range before leaving Maun.
Ask park staff for the current exit and onward route; pan conditions change seasonally.

sources.label: Botswana Tourism — Nxai Pan National Park
Botswana Tourism — Makgadikgadi and Nxai Pans

fuelAnchors.name: Harare
fuelAnchors.note: Fill and check current highway conditions before heading east.

fuelAnchors.name: Mutare
fuelAnchors.note: Principal regional fuel and supply base for Bvumba and Chimanimani.

fuelAnchors.name: Nyanga
fuelAnchors.note: Reconfirm fuel locally before highland excursions.

gatePermitNotes: Confirm Nyanga National Park and Chimanimani access, tariffs and opening hours with ZimParks or the booked operator.
Highland rain, mist and damaged road surfaces can lengthen transfers; avoid committing to a remote arrival after dark.

legs.guidance: Obtain current road advice from the accommodation because mapping may prefer minor mountain roads.
Use Mutare as the fuel and route check, then follow the booked property's approach rather than a direct mountain shortcut.

sources.label: Zimbabwe Tourism Authority — Eastern Highlands operators

fuelAnchors.name: Dwangwa
fuelAnchors.note: Malawi Tourism specifically identifies Dwangwa as a useful lakeshore place to stock up and refuel.

fuelAnchors.name: Mzuzu
fuelAnchors.note: Main northern supply base before Viphya, Rumphi and Nyika.

fuelAnchors.name: Karonga
fuelAnchors.note: Northern lakeshore fuel and supply endpoint; confirm current availability.

gatePermitNotes: Confirm Nyika entry, accommodation and the current plateau-road condition before leaving Mzuzu or Rumphi.
The historic Livingstonia escarpment road is steep, narrow and unsurfaced; use a well-maintained high-clearance vehicle or confirm the alternative approach.

legs.guidance: Use Dwangwa for the official tourism site's recommended stock-up and fuel stop.
Confirm park entry, plateau-road condition, fuel range and accommodation check-in before leaving the main corridor.
Do not treat the historic escarpment road as an ordinary transfer; confirm vehicle suitability, brakes and the safer current approach.

fuelAnchors.name: Quthing
fuelAnchors.note: Fill and provision before continuing through the Senqu valley.

fuelAnchors.name: Qacha's Nek
fuelAnchors.note: Last named town and overnight anchor before remote Sehlabathebe access.

gatePermitNotes: Visit Lesotho says the main Quthing–Qacha's Nek road is surfaced and suitable for a roadworthy car, but the Sehlabathebe continuation is a roughly three-hour unsurfaced road.
Keep Lake Letsie and Tsatsane diversions for a suitable 4×4 plan; confirm Sehlabathebe entry and accommodation before leaving Qacha's Nek.

legs.guidance: Allow at least the official site's roughly three-hour unsurfaced-road guidance, then add weather and stop margin; confirm current condition locally.

fuelAnchors.name: Mbabane
fuelAnchors.note: Begin the northern circuit with fuel, cash and offline directions.

fuelAnchors.name: Piggs Peak
fuelAnchors.note: Northwest supply check between Maguga, Nsangwini and Phophonyane.

fuelAnchors.name: Simunye
fuelAnchors.note: The official itinerary recommends stocking up here for the lowveld reserves and Shewula sector.

gatePermitNotes: The official northern circuit links Malolotja, Maguga, Nsangwini and Phophonyane with Hlane and Shewula; confirm each community stay or reserve before arrival.
Check Hlane gate and activity times with Big Game Parks and obtain Shewula's current final-approach directions.

legs.guidance: Use Simunye as the official itinerary's supply reset and navigate to the confirmed Hlane entrance.
Confirm the community camp booking and final mountain approach rather than routing only to the settlement coordinate.

sources.label: Big Game Parks — official parks portal
